core.text: Model-derived candidate: inspect continuously from boundary 0; trolley B4-B7 during 0-3, trolley B8-B11 during 3-6, then hand carry B12 during 6-7. At 6, inspection completion leaves B7 alone, permitting the four-carrier unload. At 7, B7 completion permits B12 unloading. Predicted result: nine source unloads, twelve correct releases by 13, seven occupied transfer minutes, no transfer wait. This sequence is a calculation, not an observed run.

Closest distinct archive rival: consecutive hand trips beginning at 0, predicted to unload nine source carriers using nine occupied transfer minutes while continuous inspection finishes at 13. Separating probe: ledger-replay both permitted sequences, recording identities, correct completion times, occupied intervals, rack occupancy and charge. Defeat the candidate if any whole-load unload blocks, inspection idles, a seal is incorrect, or completion exceeds 13; seven minutes cannot compensate for incomplete release. Inspection burden remains thirteen minutes in both calculations.

residue.text: B9 has the ordinary ten-bracket mark but actually contains nine. Its correction consumes the available spare and requires two inspection minutes. The mark cannot establish correct release. The discrepancy cause is unknown and supports no additional failure assumption.

The active inspection occupies a rack place. Loads unload entirely together; insufficient space keeps both vehicle and transfer clerk occupied. Completion frees space before unloading. Two trolley starts consume all charge even with partial loads. Source and inspection order cannot change. Extra capacity, charging and bypasses are unavailable. Batch size alone therefore cannot establish a burden advantage.

Three initially supplied carriers still require inspection: P1 output has denominator nine and P2 twelve. Only correct completed seals by 13 count; transfer burden ranks complete successes. No later request adaptation is observed, and no further arrivals occur here. No empirical comparison or globally best-operation proof is supplied.

tension.account_a: Capacity-aware trolley batching saves transfer labor while supplying uninterrupted inspection.
tension.account_b: Whole-load rack blockage erases the apparent batching saving and makes hand delivery preferable.
